description: What the Mac and the desktop client both say and decide for a writing document, outside the wire: how the three sections are named, how counts read, what an empty section and the new-document form say, what the new-document form submits, which entries a search keeps, how a pane names its file, when closing asks first, and what the selection toolbar of a text offers and which keys apply a format. The engine owns the rest (the file name made from a title, the word count, the autosave of a draft after limits.editorAutosaveMs, and the conflict of a draft with the disk): a client shows what the engine sent. Both clients pass every case. sectionFilter.entries are the listed documents; each case keeps the entries whose title or path contains the trimmed query, ignoring case, and keeps all of them for a blank query.
